All tasks complete. Here's what was implemented:

### New files
- **`src/cache.ts`** — `CacheManager` class managing `.ssg-cache.json` with SHA256 file hashing, staleness detection, pruning of deleted pages, and template hash computation
- **`src/incremental.ts`** — `generateSiteIncremental()` function that skips unchanged pages, rebuilds index only when needed, handles `--clean` flag
- **`src/__tests__/incremental.test.ts`** — 22 jest tests covering incremental builds, cache persistence, template change detection, stats reporting, and `CacheManager` unit tests

### Modified files
- **`src/types.ts`** — added `BuildStats` interface (`pagesBuilt`, `pagesSkipped`, `totalPages`)
- **`src/cli.ts`** — added `--incremental` and `--clean` flags; routes to incremental build when `--incremental` is set
- **`src/index.ts`** — exports new types and functions (`generateSiteIncremental`, `BuildStats`, `CacheManager`, etc.)

### How it works
- `ssg build --incremental` builds only pages whose source `.md` file or template files have changed
- File hashes are tracked in `.ssg-cache.json` in the output directory
- `ssg build --incremental --clean` forces a full rebuild and resets the cache
- Missing or corrupted cache triggers a clean build automatically
- Build stats report pages built vs skipped
